_comment: faraday settings — drop this at ~/.faraday/settings.json (user) or <project>/.faraday/settings.json (project, wins). All keys optional; shown are the built-in defaults plus the dirge-style surface. The field-by-field reference is docs/settings.md. Never put a raw api_key here; prefer api_key_env and keep keys in env or ~/.nodecode/auth.json. api_key (and the value api_key_env points at) may start with '!' to run a token helper command, e.g. "api_key": "!op read op://private/deepseek", or "!pass show DeepSeek/API". Add sandbox.nix_flake (e.g. ".#default") to layer a nix devShell into the sandbox; needs nix + flakes on the host.
